csv_project_name: DB for Boulders Road Extension & Eastern Avenue
csv_scope_of_work: Element 1 - UPC 128638 Boulders Road Extended Project. As part of the Rivanna Futures development, a new roadway will be constructed that extends existing Boulders Road to become the fourth leg to the US 29 and Austin Drive intersection. The County intends to advertise a Best Value design build request for proposals in 2026 to acquire a design-build team to deliver the public roadway improvements. The Boulders Road Extension Project includes the construction of 2,300 Linear Feet (LF) extending from the existing terminus of Boulders Road, one urban single lane roundabout, and a proposed Thru-Cut Intersection including traffic signal modifications at the proposed intersection of Boulders Road and Route 29. Element 2 - UPC 121389 Eastern Avenue South Connection The proposed improvements total approximately 3,000 linear feet and generally involve the construction of a two-lane undivided typical section with a crossing over Lickinghole Creek. The proposed improvements will consist of evaluating and recommending a preferred alignment for Eastern Avenue from Route 250 (Rockfish Gap Turnpike) to the existing northern beginning point of Eastern Avenue at Westhall Drive. This will include a proposed major structure crossing of Lickinghole Creek, a perennial stream with a FEMA regulated floodplain and floodway.
